title: MV Is there a way to hide the main Battle HUD on browser?

posts.author: RevengeOfTheKing
posts.body: I'm using SRD's HUD Maker for my game, and I previously had exported it to web and saw that my customized HUD didn't load on that version. I checked these forums for a fix, and I found a fix that almost worked, but the original RPG Maker Mv HUD is still there, just layered on top of my HUD. Is there a way I can just hide the original HUD?
